A Message to Our Graduates

Today marks not an ending, but a beginning. You have studied the Word, wrestled with the great doctrines of the faith, and sat under sound teaching. Now you go — not in your own strength, but carrying the authority of the risen Christ.

The world you are entering is hungry for what you carry. Truth, grace, the hope of the Gospel — these are not small things. They are the most powerful forces in human history. Go and deploy them fearlessly.

We are proud of each of you. But more importantly, the God who called you is faithful to complete in you what He has begun. He does not call the equipped — He equips the called.

— Rev. Victor Chidi Nnaji, Founder & General Overseer

"And I am sure of this, that he who began a good work in you will bring it to completion at the day of Jesus Christ." — Philippians 1:6 (ESV)

The Seminary Journey

From Enrolment to Commission

Every graduate walked a path of transformation — from the first lesson to the final commission.

📖
Year One
Foundation of Faith
Students are grounded in the grand narrative of Scripture — Biblical Theology from Genesis to Revelation, the doctrines of salvation, and the foundations of Christian living.
📜
Year Two
Theological Formation
Deep study in Systematic Theology, New Testament Greek, Hermeneutics, and Church History. Students learn to handle the Word of God with precision and integrity.
🕊
Year Three
Practical Ministry
Hands-on training in preaching, pastoral care, evangelism, and community ministry. Students are placed in ministry contexts under the supervision of experienced pastors.
🎓
Graduation
The Commission
At commencement, each graduate is formally commissioned and sent out — not merely to hold a certificate, but to fulfil the Great Commission in their generation.
